theme: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY (Premium, Depth, Elegance) - Light Mode Optimized

headings.usage: Used for all main headings (H1, H2, H3), property titles, and editorial quotes. Must use tight tracking (tracking-tight) to feel sophisticated and 'Awwwards-level' editorial.

body.usage: Used for property details, descriptions, UI elements, and admin dashboard. Should have a clean, sterile contrast to the ornate serif.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Import these fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500&family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;500;600&display=swap'); Apply them in tailwind.config.js.

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: The site must use 'Soft Bone White' (#F7F5F0) instead of pure white for the main background to convey an 'old money' editorial feel. High contrast text (#141414) is mandatory. Do not use generic blue or purple. The admin dashboard can use more sterile white (#FFFFFF) for utility but should retain the accent colors.

grids_and_layouts.marketing_pages: Use 'MODE A: THE TETRIS GRID'. Prioritize asymmetry. Use large imagery taking up 60-80% of the viewport. Do not perfectly center everything. Align text blocks optically with generous negative space (e.g., py-24, gap-12).
grids_and_layouts.property_cards: Cardless design or 1px subtle borders (border-[#E6E1D6]). High-aspect ratio images (e.g., aspect-[3/4] or aspect-square) to look like an art gallery, not a Craigslist ad. Details below the image: Price in Serif, Location in small uppercase sans-serif.
grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: Use 'MODE B: HIGH DENSITY GRID'. Standard sidebar/header layout. Use Shadcn components heavily here to ensure function over form, but style the active states with the #8C7B65 accent color.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: For sticky headers, use 'Glassmorphism (Crystal)' with backdrop-blur-xl and bg-[#F7F5F0]/70. Never use completely transparent headers. For property detail modals, use Solid Backgrounds to ensure readability.
visual_enhancers.motion: Use smooth, slow transitions. Property images should subtly scale up on hover (duration-700 ease-out). Page elements should stagger in on mount. Avoid 'bouncy' animations. Everything must feel grounded and heavy.
visual_enhancers.borders_and_shadows: Rely on 1px solid borders rather than drop shadows for structural elements. If shadows are needed (e.g., for dropdowns), use very diffuse, elegant shadows: shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)].

component_guidelines.hero_section: Editorial style. Large background or side-by-side split. If background image is used, overlay must be max bg-black/40. Headline must be massive (text-5xl md:text-7xl) serif.
component_guidelines.property_listing_grid: Grid with 1-3 columns. Images must be high-quality and unconstrained. On hover, the 'WhatsApp' contact button can gently fade in or slide up.
component_guidelines.whatsapp_button: Do not make it generic green unless strictly required by client. A sleek dark pill or minimal outline button with a WhatsApp icon is preferred to keep the luxury vibe.
component_guidelines.admin_forms: Use Shadcn Input, Form, Button, Table. Clean, well-spaced, standard validation.
component_guidelines.icons: Use 'lucide-react' with a consistent stroke width (1.5 or 1). Do not use emojis.

hero_main.description: Two-story luxury modern house. Use for hero section or featured listing.

property_exterior_1.description: Stylish modern white house exterior with palm trees.

property_exterior_2.description: White and brown concrete building, highly architectural.

broker_portrait.description: Elegant business portrait for the 'About the Broker' section.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: 1. All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. 2. Do not center everything; use left-aligned typography for reading flow. 3. Add transitions on hover but exclude transforms from generic 'transition-all'. 4. Never use 🤖🧠 etc emojis. 5. Portuguese language copy only. 6. Real estate is about emotion: emphasize photography and negative space.
